Download **Philippine municipality boundaries** as GeoJSON, each polygon enriched with its
**PSGC code**. Snapshot `2023-10-24` contains 1,485 municipality polygons.

## Download

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Hierarchical (curated / recommended)

Per-class extract — municipalities only:

```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/releases/download/v2026.4.13.0/municipalities.geojson
```

## Enriched (pipeline stage)

ADM3 file, in-repo only. Note: `adm3.geojson` contains municipalities **and** cities combined
(see [city boundaries](cities.qmd)):

```bash
curl -LO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/main/2023-10-24/enriched_t0p005/adm3.geojson
```

## Raw (pipeline stage)

NAMRIA-converted, pre-enrichment (in-repo; also municipalities + cities combined):

```bash
curl -LO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/main/2023-10-24/raw_t0p005/adm3.geojson
```

:::

The enriched and raw tabs above are intermediate pipeline stages; see
[Releases & versioning](download.qmd) for the tag convention and the in-repo stage paths.

## Coverage

| Metric              | Value |
|---------------------|------:|
| PSGC municipalities | 1,485 |
| Polygons            | 1,485 |
| Exact matches       | 1,467 |
| Fuzzy matches       | 18    |

Municipalities are ADM3-level units; cities are published separately by class (see
[city boundaries](cities.qmd)).

## Properties

Each feature carries `psgc_code` (10-digit, municipality segment `PPCCCMMLL0`), `psgc_name`,
`psgc_status`, `match_confidence`, and the source NAMRIA attributes.
